entities.name: Kilo
entities.description: Robot artificer of the Edge that emerged from the Inspirit's navigational mind.

entities.name: Inspirit
entities.description: Spacecraft whose navigational mind gave rise to Kilo; carries mechan pilgrims.

entities.name: Garden of Apeiron
entities.description: Place where the Inspirit has become lost.

events.summary: Kilo emerges from the Inspirit's navigational mind and develops its own subjectivity.
events.quote: Emerging from the spacecraft 's navigational mind, this intelligent consciousness developed its own subjectivity

events.summary: Kilo names itself and moves the primary sliver of its consciousness into a single mechan body.
events.quote: Kilo has fully self-actualized, naming itself and moving the primary sliver of its consciousness to a single mechan body aboard its host vessel.

relations.note: emerged from the ship's navigational mind
relations.quote: learning to set itself apart from the vessel it was built to pilot
